extensions.name: Arrow IPC Parser
extensions.description: Message parser for self-describing Arrow IPC streams.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: BLF Loader
extensions.description: Data loader for Vector BLF (Binary Logging Format) CAN logs, decoded to signals via DBC.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: CSV Loader
extensions.description: Data loader for CSV files.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: DataTamer Parser
extensions.description: Message parser for DataTamer encoded data. Efficient serialization for robotics.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Dummy Streamer
extensions.description: Generates synthetic sine, cosine, sawtooth, and noise signals for testing and demonstration.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Foxglove Bridge
extensions.description: Connect to Foxglove WebSocket server for ROS data streaming. Compatible with Foxglove Studio.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: JSON Parser
extensions.description: Message parser for JSON, CBOR, MessagePack, and BSON encoded data.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: LeRobot Loader
extensions.description: Data loader for LeRobot v2.x and v3.0 datasets: flattened numeric series + per-camera video on a shared timeline. v3.0 datasets use a consolidated per-shard Parquet/MP4 layout with relational metadata; the plugin reads meta/episodes/*.parquet to resolve each episode's row range and clip window.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Lab Streaming Layer
extensions.description: Real-time streaming from Lab Streaming Layer (LSL) sources, including numeric and marker (string) streams.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: MCAP Loader
extensions.description: Data loader for MCAP files and split ROS 2 bags (metadata.yaml). Supports ROS1, ROS2, Protobuf, and JSON message encodings.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: MF4/MDF Loader
extensions.description: Data loader for ASAM MDF / MF4 measurement files (automotive, CAN/LIN bus logging).
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: MP4 Loader
extensions.description: Data loader for .mp4 video files. Reads the container's creation_time tag (when present) so the host can anchor the video on a wall-clock timeline; supports multi-file selection via the standard File dialog.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: MQTT Subscriber
extensions.description: Real-time data streaming via MQTT protocol. Subscribe to topics and visualize live data.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Parquet Loader
extensions.description: Data loader for Apache Parquet files. Efficient columnar storage format.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: PlotJuggler Bridge
extensions.description: Connect to PlotJuggler Bridge server for generic data streaming over WebSocket.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: 3D Loader (PLY/PCD)
extensions.description: Data loader for static 3D files: .pcd and vertex-only .ply load as a point cloud; .ply with faces loads as a 3D mesh. One snapshot at timestamp 0.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Protobuf Parser
extensions.description: Message parser for Protocol Buffers encoded data. Promotes the well-known Foxglove schemas (PointCloud, CompressedVideo, CompressedImage, RawImage, ImageAnnotations, SceneUpdate, FrameTransform, PosesInFrame, CameraCalibration, VoxelGrid, Grid) to builtin scene objects.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: ROS CDR Parser
extensions.description: Message parser for ROS1 and ROS2 messages (ros1msg, ros2msg, omgidl). Promotes common sensor and visualization messages (Image, PointCloud2, OccupancyGrid, GridMap, TF, Markers, and yolo_msgs/DetectionArray to ImageAnnotations) to builtin scene objects.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: ROS 2 Topic Subscriber
extensions.description: Subscribe to ROS 2 topics in real time and stream the decoded fields into PlotJuggler.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Anomaly Detector
extensions.description: Write Lua anomaly rules over time series and emit plot markers (regions / events) when a rule fires.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Assistant Agent
extensions.description: A chat assistant that drives PlotJuggler through the plugin SDK: lists and describes topics, reads series statistics, and creates derived timeseries, markers and plot tabs it owns. Uses the Claude Code or Codex CLI already installed and signed in on your machine; the plugin stores no API keys. Linux, macOS and Windows.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: CSV/Parquet Exporter
extensions.description: Export selected time series to CSV or Parquet files.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Fast Fourier Transform
extensions.description: Compute the frequency-domain amplitude of numeric time series using FFT.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Mosaico Cloud Server
extensions.description: Browse and import data from Mosaico cloud servers via Apache Arrow Flight. Scalar topics are handed to the host as arrow-ipc messages and decoded by the parser_arrow plugin (install it alongside). Includes Lua metadata predicate filter, multi-topic streaming, and time-range selection.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Quaternion to RPY
extensions.description: Converts quaternion (x, y, z, w) time series into Roll, Pitch, Yaw angles with optional unwrapping and degree/radian output.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: Transform Editor
extensions.description: Create named derived time series using Lua functions. Equivalent to the Custom Series editor in PJ3.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: UDP Server
extensions.description: Real-time data streaming via UDP. Supports unicast and multicast IPv4/IPv6.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: ULog Loader
extensions.description: Data loader for PX4 ULog files. Flight log format for PX4 autopilot.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: WebRTC Video Client
extensions.description: Receives live H.264 video via standard WHEP (mediamtx, go2rtc, LiveKit, Cloudflare Stream...) and feeds each stream to PlotJuggler as canonical PJ.VideoFrame messages. One HTTP request per stream, per-camera reconnect, mediamtx Control API discovery. H.264 pass-through; no transcode.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: ZMQ Subscriber
extensions.description: Real-time data streaming via ZeroMQ. High-performance messaging for distributed systems.
extensions.author: PlotJuggler Team

extensions.name: ArduPilot Bin
extensions.description: Data loader for ArduPilot DataFlash (.bin) logs. Ported from the Airbound PlotJuggler 3 fork of ArduPilot/plotjuggler-apbin-plugins.
extensions.author: Pierre Kancir, Jonas Withelm, Airbound
